idea-plugin.name: Ki Data (KD)
idea-plugin.description:
Support for Ki Data (KD) files in IntelliJ-based IDEs.

KD is a modern, readable document format for structured data with support for:

  • Rich type system: strings, numbers, dates, durations, versions, geo-coordinates, and more
  • Hierarchical tag structure with annotations, values, and attributes
  • Units of measure (e.g., 5cm, 23.5kg)
  • Ranges, lists, maps, and grids
  • Unicode and emoji support

Learn more at Ki.Docs
